judgment.label: incorrect
judgment.mode_quote: Adobe's operating margin profile declined slightly in 2022 compared to 2021
judgment.reason: Reference states operating margin declined from 36.8% (FY2021) to 34.6% (FY2022), a drop of 2.2%. Candidate says margin declined to 35% from 37% (approx, but wrong magnitudes) and calls it 'improving' implicitly false; question asks if improving, answer should be no. Candidate gave declined but with wrong figures (35%/37% vs 34.6%/36.8%) and did not state 'no, not improving' clearly as required; evidence shows operating income 6098/17606=34.6%, 5802/15785=36.8%, matching reference not candidate.
